reasoning: Base ratings: the Mavericks are +1.1 and the Pacers -5.7 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Mavericks 10.8 better here, total 227.
Rest, travel and availability move it 2.2 towards the Pacers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: Mavericks by 8.3, 66% to win; total 226 (80% range 201-250).
